items.question: How does Nonnapp generate recipes?
items.answer: An AI looks at what you tell it — ingredients, time available, your cooking preferences — and generates a complete recipe with clear steps in a matter of seconds.

items.question: Can I use only the ingredients I have at home?
items.answer: Yes, pantry mode prioritizes the ingredients you give it. It's available on the La Mamma and La Nonna plans; on the free plan you can describe what you feel like in free-text mode.

items.question: Can I save my favorite recipes?
items.answer: Every recipe you generate is saved automatically to your history, so you can always come back to it whenever you like.

items.question: Does Nonnapp take allergies or preferences into account?
items.answer: Yes — you can enter allergies, ingredients you dislike, and your cooking level so every recipe suits you. Cooking level is free on every plan; allergy and ingredient personalization is on the paid plans.

items.question: Is Nonnapp free to use?
items.answer: Yes, the Il Nipote plan is free forever (2 recipes a day). If you want unlimited recipes and more personalization, you can move up to La Mamma or La Nonna whenever you like.
